Coffee & food

What is on the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Coffee

Cypriot coffee and good coffee in general, as guests write. In the evening also wine and cold beer.

Breakfast and brunch

Toast, eggs, cheese, cold cuts, olives and jam. One guest calls it their favourite brunch in Nicosia.

Homemade cakes

Guests praise the homemade snacks and cakes, such as the marble cake, and the homemade jam.

Salads and small dishes

Greek salad, stuffed vine leaves and other light dishes for lunch or a glass in the evening.

The house and the yard

Photos from the Google listing of Kafenio 11.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

The yard

A walled courtyard with a tree in the middle, colourful tables and bougainvillea. Guests say it relaxes you the moment you step in.

Music

Jazz and songs from the 50s and 60s, and on some evenings live music, rebetiko among it. 11 reviews mention the live music.

Like at home

29 reviews mention the friendly staff. Guests write that they feel at home right away.

An old house in the old town

Kafenio 11 sits in a well kept old building in the small streets of old Nicosia, decorated with old objects, tiles and plants. Guests come for coffee in the morning, for lunch, or for a glass and music in the evening. Open from 10:30, closed on Mondays.

What guests say

Three of 447 Google reviews, 351 of them with five stars.

“Small cosy cafe with a beautiful small yard. Staff are very friendly and make you feel at home right away. Home made snacks and cakes are delicious and prices low. Don’t miss it if you are in the area.”

Google review
“This place is addictive: our favourite brunch in Nicosia with a quietly quirky, jazzy vibe.”

Google review
“Just discovered it and fell in love at first sight. A cafe with character and a warm and friendly one to boot. The backyard garden is one of these spaces that relaxes you the moment you step in. Altogether a genuinely unique cafe that you won't find at every corner.”
